editorialNote: Four stories. Beloved son → sold and far from home → prison to palace → the family forgiven. Four is above the kid sweet spot (3) but within the 3-5 cap — Adam explicitly ratified 4 because dropping the King's-Dreams beat (1860) leaves the prison-to-palace rise unexplained: without it, the forgiving Joseph of 1819 appears at the king's side with no path out of the dungeon. Kid register spine is feeling-first: God stays WITH Joseph in every room he never chose. Mood run encouraging → anxious → encouraging → encouraging; 1906 is the arc's one deliberate anxious beat, and the ratified offer_1 look-back resolves it in-line ('we waited with Joseph in the dark, and God stayed right beside him').
